description: This file defines a set of functions in CMake scripting language for constructing JSON structures. It includes callbacks for starting and ending JSON objects and arrays, handling key-value pairs, literals, and managing the JSON context. The main function 'json' initializes the context, executes provided callbacks, and produces a JSON string.

methods.name: json
methods.description: Main entry point that initializes the JSON context, executes callbacks, and returns the constructed JSON string.

methods.name: json_obj_begin
methods.description: Callback to begin a JSON object, appending '{' to the current JSON string.

methods.name: json_obj_end
methods.description: Callback to end a JSON object, appending '}' to the current JSON string.

methods.name: json_array_begin
methods.description: Callback to begin a JSON array, appending '[' to the current JSON string.

methods.name: json_array_end
methods.description: Callback to end a JSON array, appending ']' to the current JSON string.

methods.name: json_obj_keyvalue_begin
methods.description: Callback to start a key-value pair within a JSON object, inserting the key and colon.

methods.name: json_obj_keyvalue_end
methods.description: Callback to end a key-value pair, adding a comma if needed.

methods.name: json_array_element_end
methods.description: Callback to end an array element, adding a comma if needed.

methods.name: json_literal
methods.description: Handles literals such as null, boolean, numbers, and strings, appending them appropriately in JSON format.
